description: Fresh, untouched held-out split for the human K562 position-effect expression head. Sealed via SHA-locked prereg and run ONCE before scoring (not a within-dataset re-selection).
label: measured Leemans 2019 K562 TRIP steady-state integrated-reporter expression (NON-circular: the measured label, not a model claim)

chrom_holdout.rationale: held out by whole chromosome (leakage control: nearby integrations share chromatin); this split was never used as a test set before the fresh sealed run.

acceptance.rule: the circularity-clean independent variant must beat the best LEARNED heterochromatin baseline by delta>=0.05 with the bootstrap 95% CI of the margin excluding 0

baselines: heterochromatin_multifeature (learned LightGBM on lad + LMNB1-DamID + H3K9me3 + H3K27me3)

provenance.run: sealed and run once (per the sealed execution record changelog, 2026-07-05d); RNG seed not recorded in the available source files
provenance.note_distinct_split: the pre-registered mouse-axis validated_null used a DIFFERENT held-out split {chr2,chr9,chr16} (prereg 2a4c722a...); this file documents ONLY the fresh human-head split {chr3,chr8,chr12}
